browserNotOpening.title: Browser Not Opening
browserNotOpening.description: Check your config has headless: false:

aiNotResponding.title: AI Not Responding
solutions: Check your OpenAI API key in .env
Make sure you have API credits

commandsNotWorking.title: Commands Not Working
solutions: Be more specific ("click the Submit button" not "click")
Use exact text you see on screen

bestPractices.title: 🎯 Best Practices
items: Start Simple - Record basic flows first
Test Happy Paths - Get the normal flow working
Add Edge Cases - Record error scenarios separately
Use Good Names - Make test IDs descriptive
Verify Results - Always check actions worked

cliApi.title: Non-Interactive Mode (CLI API)
cliApi.description: The test recorder also provides a programmable CLI API for automated test creation. It is used by Claude Code skills and can be invoked directly.

whenCli.title: When to Use CLI API
items: Automation - Create tests from scripts or CI/CD pipelines
Claude Code Integration - Use the /write-test skill for AI-guided test creation
Batch Test Creation - Generate multiple tests programmatically
Custom Workflows - Build custom test creation tools

whenInteractive.title: When to Use Interactive Mode
items: Manual Testing - Direct control over each step
Visual Feedback - See browser actions in real-time
Learning - Understand how the recorder works
Complex Scenarios - Situations requiring human judgment
